subject: Live demo scheduling — vendor questionnaire & SSO test required
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@meditrust.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Live demo request — tentative week of Mar 8

Hi Nikhil / Priyom,

Thanks for the quick responses. Procurement has flagged that we need a completed vendor questionnaire and an executed NDA before we can run a live, exec-facing demo. Can you share your standard questionnaire and the NDA link? Once procurement signs off we can lock a slot — we were hoping for the week of Mar 8 but that may be optimistic.

Also note: our SSO team will want a test account provisioned (SAML) prior to the session so we can validate our IdP flow. Can you confirm if Redwood can provide a short SSO test plan and a sandbox account?

Elena
Elena Morales
Director, Vendor Governance
Meditrust Health

Attachments: none
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@meditrust.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Live demo request — tentative week of Mar 8

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up.

Short answer: yes, we can provide both the questionnaire and an NDA link. A couple of operational notes so we set expectations: our security/compliance review of a completed vendor questionnaire typically takes 3–4 business days, and SSO provisioning + an IdP smoke test usually needs an engineer window (we can do a 30–45 minute session to validate SAML). Given those constraints + a couple of travel windows on our side the week of Mar 8 looks tight.

Options to keep momentum:
- We can record a focused 20–25 minute walkthrough of the product (no PII in recording) and share it this week so your team can review while procurement completes intake.
- Or set a tentative live demo for the following week (we're thinking Mar 15–19) and treat the calendar invite as tentative pending questionnaire completion / SSO test.

Priyom, I can hand this to you to coordinate the questionnaire work and a placeholder invite.

Thanks,
Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Head of Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

We can do the SSO smoke test as soon as you have a sandbox account and a short test plan. If you can provide those by Wednesday we can try to run the test the same week.

Elena

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-03-02T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Live demo request — tentative week of Mar 8

Hi Elena — thanks for sending the questionnaire. I've reviewed the PDF and it looks straightforward; a few questions are internal only (hosting region and data retention defaults) — I'll loop in Laura for the hosting/ops answers.

I'm attaching a short mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones: questionnaire return, legal NDA, SSO sandbox test, and a proposed placeholder demo on Mar 17 (we picked a date after the week of Mar 8 to allow time for intake). If you prefer to keep a week-of-Mar-8 placeholder, let me know and we'll mark it tentative.

Action items:
- Priyom: send completed questionnaire (2 business days)
- Laura: confirm SSO sandbox window and engineer availability
- Elena: confirm procurement will prioritize the questionnaire once received

I'll upload the MAP to HubSpot and share the DocuSign NDA link once legal gives the go-ahead.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise AE — Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 646-555-0199

Attachments: MAP_Meditrust_WeekOfMar8.xlsx (attachment stub)
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-03T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Meditrust demo — reschedule recommendation

Priyom / Laura — quick internal note so we have alignment before I reply to procurement:

1) Procurement gating (questionnaire + NDA) is likely to push a live demo 7–10 business days out; assume we need to free up the week of Mar 15 as our target.
2) Laura — can engineering provide a 30-min SSO sandbox window the week of Mar 8 or 15? If we can get a test account provisioned quickly that reduces friction.
3) Because our PMs have travel Mar 9–11, I'm recommending we offer Meditrust either:
   - a short recorded feature walkthrough this week (20–25 mins) + live SSO smoke test when available, or
   - hold a tentative live demo for Mar 17 and treat the invite as conditional on questionnaire completion/NDA.

I'll propose both options to procurement and make sure Priyom has the MAP and DocuSign link ready.

Nikhil

Thanks for the clarification, Nikhil/Priyom. Procurement will prioritize the questionnaire and should be able to return it in 2 business days once we have clarifying answers on hosting region and retention (Priyom / Laura: please flag those sections).

We can provision an SSO test account on our side if you can give us the exact user attributes and ACS URL; otherwise if Redwood can provision a sandbox user that would work better.

For planning purposes, let's tentatively lock Mar 17 for the live demo (11:00–12:00 PT). We will treat this as tentative until the questionnaire/NDA are completed. If you can send the DocuSign link today we will push legal to sign quickly.

Rajiv
